name: repo-work-timer
description: Monthly repository runtime for Claude Code, Codex, and terminal commands. Local logs, no focus tracking.
author: Suraj M Durgad

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reads local agent logs and repository process metadata only in trusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Requires a filesystem and local process access.

commands.title: Repo Work Timer: Controls and Logs
Repo Work Timer: Import Agent History
Repo Work Timer: Export Monthly CSV

repoWorkTimer.enabled.description: Track agent and terminal runtime for repositories in this workspace.

repoWorkTimer.staleAgentMinutes.description: Stop counting an unfinished agent session after this many minutes without a log update. Running terminal commands are independent of this crash safeguard.

repoWorkTimer.codexHome.description: Codex data directory. Empty uses CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

repoWorkTimer.claudeHome.description: Claude Code data directory. Empty uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

repoWorkTimer.externalTerminals.description: Also detect commands in external local terminals on macOS and Linux. Idle shells do not count.
